classifier.SUBSTRING_REQUIRED: quoted, wildcards, punctuation splits, blob/unknown field

classifier.spaced_pipe: bare | token skipped (existing AND); compact a|b is OR
classifier.drive_letter_path: C:\... remains unknown field C blob fallback

parameterization: all hunt search atoms bound as ClickHouse parameters; no interpolation of user text into SQL
